title: How to make the most of your masked language model for protein engineering
abstract: arXiv:2603.10302v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A plethora of protein language models have been released in recent years. Yet comparatively little work has addressed how to best sample from them to optimize desired biological properties. We fill this gap by proposing a flexible, effective sampling method for masked language models (MLMs), and by systematically evaluating models and methods both in silico and in vitro on actual antibody therapeutics campaigns. Firstly, we propose sampling with stochastic beam search, exploiting the fact that MLMs are remarkably efficient at evaluating the pseudo-perplexity of the entire 1-edit neighborhood of a sequence. Reframing generation in terms of entire-sequence evaluation enables flexible guidance with multiple optimization objectives. Secondly, we report results from our extensive in vitro head-to-head evaluation for the antibody engineering setting. translated_title: 如何充分利用你的掩码语言模型进行蛋白质工程
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.10302v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：近年来，涌现了大量蛋白质语言模型。然而，相对较少的工作关注如何最好地从这些模型中进行采样以优化所需的生物特性。我们通过提出一种灵活、有效的掩码语言模型（MLM）采样方法，并系统地评估模型和方法在计算机模拟和实际抗体治疗活动中的表现，来填补这一空白。首先，我们提出了使用随机束搜索的采样方法，利用MLM在评估序列的1-编辑邻域的伪困惑度方面极为高效的特点。通过将生成重新定义为全序列评估，可以实现多优化目标的灵活引导。其次，我们报告了在抗体工程环境中进行的广泛体外头对头评估结果。这揭示了采样方法的选择可能产生显著影响，这激励了我们的工作。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于随机束搜索的掩码语言模型采样方法，并在抗体工程中通过体外实验验证了其对优化蛋白质特性的重要性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a stochastic beam search sampling method for masked language models, validated through in vitro experiments in antibody engineering, highlighting its importance for optimizing protein properties.
